enrichment.core_claim: Meditation and psilocybin offer complementary windows on how perception and self-experience change, with ongoing research on combining mindfulness and psilocybin.
enrichment.ask_question: Where do meditation and psilocybin diverge most in their effects on the experience of self?
enrichment.challenge_question: How do you control for expectancy when experienced meditators and psychedelic participants know what states to expect?
